free_tier.stated: A membership whose monthly fee buys a fixed block of GPU hours, which is the cheapest denominator found anywhere. Quoted: HyperAI Pro at USD 4.99 per month includes 30 GPU hours per month usable on a single RTX 5090, so a fully used month is USD 0.1663 per 32 GB GPU-hour, with no carry-over: 'Any remaining quota will be cleared at the beginning of the following month'. On-demand rates on the same site: RTX 5090 32GB USD 0.35/hr, RTX PRO 6000 96GB USD 0.80/hr, H100 PCIe 80GB USD 1.80/hr. Basic is quoted at USD 0.00 to get started with 20 GB of storage and a free CPU container of 2 vCPU and 4 GB RAM.
